events.name: Bash
events.head: Check git state and T-235 code presence
events.input: $ git status --short -- cloud app/scripts/probe-tantra-reminders.mjs | head -20; echo ---; git log --oneline -8 -- cloud/src/followups.ts cloud/src/followup-copy.ts cloud/migrations/0024_followups.sql app/scripts/probe-tantra-reminders.mjs cloud/admin-ui/admin.js; echo ---; git rev-list --left-right --count origin/main...HEAD; echo ---; grep -n "engagement_nudge_threshold\|tantra_followups" cloud/admin-ui/admin.js cloud/src/settings.ts cloud/src/index.ts cloud/src/followups.ts | head -30; echo ---; grep -n "runFollowups" cloud/src/*.ts | head; echo ---; grep -n "publish held" /Users/adithyamur

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read probe usage, unpushed commits, migration and wrangler config
events.input: $ sed -n 20,60p app/scripts/probe-tantra-reminders.mjs; echo ---; git log --oneline origin/main..HEAD; echo; git log -1 --format='%h %cd' origin/main; grep -n "publish held" -i /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md | tail -3; echo ---; cat cloud/migrations/0024_followups.sql | head -30; ls cloud/wrangler*; grep -n "database_name\|^name\|\[env" cloud/wrangler.toml | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check whether T-235 commit is on origin and how local stack is started
events.input: $ git branch -r --contains 83edbc4 | head -3; git status --short -- cloud/src cloud/admin-ui cloud/migrations cloud/scripts app/scripts/probe-tantra-reminders.mjs; echo ---; grep -n "database_name\|\"name\"\|SIM_URL\|\"env\"" cloud/wrangler.jsonc | head; echo ---; grep -rn "8960\|8882" --include=*.sh --include=*.json --include=*.md -l . 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | head -8; lsof -iTCP:8960 -iTCP:8882 -sTCP:LISTEN -P 2>/dev/null | tail -3; grep -n "8960\|8882" .claude/launch.json cloud/package.json | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find local centre and simulator start commands
events.input: $ grep -rn "8960\|8882" .claude/launch.json cloud/package.json cloud/scripts/*.sh app/scripts/*.sh cloud/README.md 2>/dev/null | head -12; echo ---; lsof -iTCP -sTCP:LISTEN -P 2>/dev/null | grep -E ":(8960|8882|87[0-9]{2}|88[0-9]{2}|89[0-9]{2}) " | head; echo ---; sed -n 1,25p cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py | head -30; ls cloud/scripts | head -30

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read local stack scripts
events.input: $ cat cloud/scripts/local-stack.sh | head -60; echo ---; cat cloud/scripts/run-dev.sh | head -30; grep -rn "probe-tantra-reminders" workshop-plan/tasks/activity/T-235.json 2>/dev/null | grep -o "SIM_PORT[^\"]\{0,200\}" | head -3

events.text: T-235's code is committed and already on origin, and the threshold field is in Cohort Settings; now bringing up an isolated local centre and simulator to run the probe.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find how earlier runs started the 8960 probe stack
events.input: $ grep -rhn "8960" app/scripts/*.sh app/scripts/*.mjs cloud/scripts/* workshop-plan/TEAM_GUIDE.md 2>/dev/null | grep -i "wrangler\|persist\|SIM_PORT" | head -8; echo ---; grep -o "wrangler dev[^\"\\\\]\{0,300\}8960[^\"\\\\]\{0,200\}" -r workshop-plan/tasks/activity/T-235.json workshop-plan/tasks/activity/T-234.json 2>/dev/null | head -3; echo ---; grep -o "persist-to[^\"\\\\]\{0,120\}" -rh workshop-plan/tasks/activity/T-23*.json app/scripts/run-chain.sh 2>/dev/null | sort | uniq -c | head -5; grep -c . cloud/.dev.vars | head -1; grep -o "^[A-Z_]*" cloud/.dev.vars | tr '\n' ' '
